issues.quote: There was only left to pack up…
No matter whether such a “must” is small or large, what matters is that each time it demands attention, that I am not giving myself to them, but that they already govern me.
that I am not giving myself to them, but that they already govern me
In effect, you become a slave to this many-headed beast.
Whereas on my own orbit I meet a person everywhere and always.
Yes, you stand in my way, and you consider that you have a right to me.
you consider that you have a right to me
you who through the windows of houses, a thousand black mouths, forever breathe out stench
in your variety of colors and forms

strengths.quote: I feel another’s existence enter mine, like air through windows and doors, like the waters of tributaries into a river.
I confess I envy the planets: they have their own orbits, and nothing gets in their way.
You lash the holy silence of the earth with the screech of factories, the thunder of wheels
You throw into my heart, as into your own hiding place, your sufferings and your pains
You do not merely walk beside me, you crawl inside me.
